Product.title: Scubapro Hybrid Cargo Shorts for Women, 1mm, XL
Product.description: Hybrid Cargo Shorts offer all of the features of Hybrid Cargo Pants, in a short design that maintains function. The form-fitting Hybrid Cargo Shorts are made of quality 1mm X-Foam neoprene and stretchy nylon. On the inside, a micro-plush lining makes the shorts warm and cozy. This plush lining absorbs less water, increasing overall warmth, plus dries quickly. Hybrid Cargo Shorts come with large hook & loop pockets featuring internal bungees and a D-ring, along with large fast-draining eyelets and an additional zippered pocket for stowing small valuables. The shorts come with an adjustable waist belt that threads through a series of belt loops and includes an easy-to-use male/female squeeze buckle closure. Anti-abrasion fabric on the seat panel enhances durability. Designed to be worn either by themselves or over a dive suit, Hybrid Cargo Shorts are perfect for enjoying a day in the water.

This plush lining absorbs less water, increasing overall warmth, plus it dries quickly. Hybrid Cargo Pants come with large hook & loop pockets featuring internal bungees and a D-ring, along with large fast-draining eyelets and an additional zippered pocket for stowing small valuables. The pants come with an adjustable waist belt that threads through a series of belt loops and includes an easy-to-use male/female squeeze buckle closure. Anti-abrasion fabric on the seat panel enhances durability.

Product.title: Scubapro Sport Hoodless Vest, 2.0 MM, 2XS
Product.description: Designed to layer with any SCUBAPRO steamer, this classic 2mm Hoodless Vest is made of 2mm limestone-based pure neoprene, lined outside with stretchy recycled polyester fabric and lined inside with stretchy and warm plush made of recycled nylon. The Sport 2mm Hoodless Vest features dark logos on the chest and spine for that modern look, and is intended to cover the torso to protect the body's thermal area. Flexible and comfortable, it's the perfect thermal addition for those times when extra thermal layering is the plan for the dive day.

Product.title: Scubapro Definition Steamer for Women, 3MM, Medium Tall
Product.description: The Definition 3mm offers a level of warmth and comfort any warm-water diver will love. It is built with SCUBAPRO's Body Map System, a manufacturing method that uses a 3D cut, special tailoring and material inserts to create a suit that fits like a glove, provides extra stretch where it's needed most, and offers excellent warmth, comfort and durability. Proven N2S (Nylon 2 Sides) construction offers the perfect level of warmth and comfort for warm-water diving. The infrared fleece interior lining reflects body heat to ratchet up warmth even more, plus it's comfortable as can be against the skin. It's the perfect thermal protection for any diver.

Product.title: Riptide Terrova QUEST 90/115 lb. Thrust, 72" Shaft, Wireless Remote, Black
Product.description: Riptide Terrova is the hardest working first mate you'll meet. One that doesn't take breaks and doesn't know the meaning of the term “day off”. With available shaft lengths up to 100” , Riptide Terrova comes ready to go where other trolling motors wont. The new QUEST series of dual 24/36 volt brushless trolling motors was designed for anglers who demand the best from their equipment – even in the harshest environments. With a reinforced motor and mount , more advanced GPS functionality than ever and even an eco mode to extend battery life , Terrova is ready to tackle the elements and feels right at home on bigger boats than ever before. | Riptide Terrova QUEST 90/115 lb. Thrust , 72" Shaft , Wireless Remote , Black

Product.pim_FeatureBulletCombo: ["These 24/36V dual-voltage brushless motors have been completely re-imagined from the ground up with updates to mounts, propellers, lift assist systems, drive motors and software – taking the world’s greatest trolling motors and redesigning them to outperform everything else on the water for years to come.", "Press this lever on the mount and fall-away ramps will effortlessly slide your trolling motor into the water. And when you're ready to move, Auto Park helps the motor stow effortlessly by orienting the lower unit to the perfect stow position automatically.", "The most-trusted navigation system in fishing. Terrova uses GPS to control your trolling motor with unrivaled features that keep you on the fish. Set Spot-Locks, record paths, control speed and steering, and more. Minn Kota makes boat positioning and control automatic, and you can take command from the easy-to-read LCD screen of Terrova's wireless remote.", "Out of the box, Minn Kota motors come standard with everything you need to connect to select Humminbird fish finders, unlocking more advanced navigation features without needing to remember additional adapters or complicated set-up procedures.", "Spot-Lock will hold you in place with unparalleled GPS accuracy. Spot-Lock gives you the power to stay right on top of any productive fishing spot, without touching your trolling motor. With the built-in heading sensor, you can use Jog to move your Spot-Lock location five feet in any direction.", "Automatically engages speed and course control simultaneously, meaning anglers no longer need to depend on drift socks, kicker motors, or manual operation to control speed over water – even in the heaviest wind and current.", "Check battery power levels while the motor is in use, real-time “time until empty” display monitor, with a notification when battery power is reduced to 20% to prompt users to enter “Eco-mode” which can reduce current draw to extend battery life.", " Provides up to 5 times longer run time on a single battery charge. These variable speed trolling motors let you dial in your exact speed, and they deliver only as much power as you need, helping to conserve your battery for a full day of fishing.", "At the core of your Minn Kota trolling motor is an indestructible composite shaft. It's a Minn Kota exclusive, and we guarantee it for life.", "Control your motor directly from your Apple® or Android™ device with the One-Boat Network app. You get quick command of speed, steering, Spot-Lock and AutoPilot — plus the ability to update software.", "Built-in technology delivers accurate steering and boat control without the need for an external heading sensor.", "Riptide Terrova QUEST 90/115 lb. 72\" motor, Wireless Remote, Lanyard, Heading Sensor, MKP-38 Prop, Stabilizer Kit / MKA-60 and Mounting Hardware", "3-Year Limited Warranty with Registration"]

Product.title: YakAttack Omega Rod Holder with Track Mounted LockNLoad Mounting System
Product.description: The last rod holder you'll ever need. The YakAttack Omega Rod Holder with Track Mounted LockNLoad Mounting System effortlessly attaches to the accessory tracks on your Old Town fishing kayak, boat, or other small craft. Product.title: SCUBAPRO Rapid System, w/ Air2 and Cloth Carry Bag
Product.description: SCUBAPRO's SRS is designed to be donned quickly in the event of an emergency, military action, or deal with any unexpected underwater situation at a moment's notice. The double horse collar-style BCD is PU coated on the outside, making it easy to sanitize and dry, and it comes with an AIR2 and double tank cinches. To create a full kit, additional products can be purchased separately including regulator systems, analog pressure gauges, knives and tools.

Product.title: Scubapro Navigator Lite BCD in Black, M-2XL
Product.description: The Navigator Lite, SCUBAPRO's new lightweight, back inflation BCD is perfect for the recreational travel diver who prefers black-flotation in a simple, yet durable form with the added benefit of showing off interesting color combinations. The Navigator Lite is built around a soft PU-coated backpack that helps it dry quickly and is durable, foldable, and travel-friendly. The Navigator Lite also offers a new feature that no other SCUBAPRO BCD has - replaceable air cell covers that come in a choice of six color options for color-customizing your dive gear. It is required that an authorized SCUBAPRO technician install the air cell covers. The BCD comes with an easy-adjust Quick Cinch tank buckle system that's teamed with a 50mm hook & loop tank strap. Together they deliver rock-solid tank stabilization in all dive conditions. The cummerbund features two detachable pockets, each with two soft D-rings. These pockets can be either placed with the opening facing upwards for carrying accessories or downwards to provide quick-release ballast. The Navigator Lite comes in two expandable sizes, XXS to M and M to XXL, with a bit of overlapping so you can be sure to find the perfect fit for your next dive travel adventure.

Product.pim_ShortDescription: Everything you need for coffee on the trail. The Flash Java 1.0L bundles our efficient Flash 1.0L cooking system with the stowable Silicone Coffee Press, which stores perfectly inside the cook pot. Jetboil's 1.0L FluxRing cooking pot with insulating cozy makes boiling water for coffee—and keeping it warm—a breeze. Start brewing instantly with the turn-and-click igniter and verify that the water's ready with the thermochromatic heat indicator. Whether it’s your first cup of the day or a boost after a long adventure, Flash Java 1.0L boils in seconds so you can fuel up faster.

Product.title: Minn Kota Ulterra QUEST Trolling Motor, 24V/36V, 90/115 lb, 45" Shaft, Humminbird Imaging-DSC, Wireless Remote, Instant Response Foot Pedal
Product.description: Minn Kota Ulterra trolling motors make boat control effortless , so you can focus on fishing—even in the harshest conditions. Choose the proven brushed performance of Minn Kota Ulterra or brushless power with Minn Kota Ulterra QUEST. Automatic stow , deploy , and trim make motor adjustments effortless , while the ultra-responsive Ulterra foot pedal and Power Steering deliver the gold standard in precise control and maneuvering. Your motor syncs easily and wirelessly with a Minn Kota fish finder powered by Humminbird Imaging , creating a connected fishing system with no extra cables. Ulterra is filled with intelligent navigation features that do the work for you. Draw & Navigate lets you draw a course on your fish finder and have the motor follow it , while Follow Mode and Drift Mode automatically guide your boat along productive water and controlled drift paths. Intelligent Depth Control actively avoids shallow water while trolling to help protect your equipment and keep you on the fish. | Minn Kota Ulterra QUEST Trolling Motor , 24V/36V , 90/115 lb , 45" Shaft , Humminbird Imaging-DSC , Wireless Remote , Instant Response Foot Pedal
Product.google_product_category: Electronics > Electronics Accessories > Remote Controls

Product.pim_ANISProductWxHDimensionsIM: 16 in x 73 in
Product.pim_FeatureBulletCombo: ["Spot-Lock® gives you up to a 50% tighter hold to your spot and the power to stay right on top of any productive fishing spot with unparalleled GPS accuracy, so you can remain where you are without touching your trolling motor. ", "Avoid shallow water and protect your equipment—this feature detects depth changes, alerts you immediately, and takes action by automatically engaging Spot-Lock® and deploying your shallow water anchors.", "Getting to your favorite spot is easier than ever. Just draw a course with your finger and the motor automatically takes you where you want to go.", "Keep your bait where the fish are by automatically following depth contours and weed lines.", "From innovative navigation features to precise boat positioning, built-in connectivity let’s you wirelessly manage compatible gear seamlessly across your Minn Kota® system. Simplify the set up and use of your integrated system without complex rigging or cables—keeping everything connected, cleaner, and more organized. ", "Minn Kota® trolling motors, fish finders, maps, sonar, and shallow water anchors all work together for one purpose—fishing. The Minn Kota® system seamlessly integrates what your fish finder sees with what your trolling motor does, turning sonar and mapping data into automated and precise boat positioning so you can stay focused on fishing.", "Easily maneuver to your spot with the most responsive and advanced foot pedal with heel to toe steering speed, a programmable button, Spot-Lock, and 6' cable.", "These 24/36V dual-voltage brushless motors have been completely re-imagined from the ground up, taking the world’s greatest trolling motors and redesigning them to outperform everything else on the water for years to come. Fish longer with the power and precision you need: 50% more torque and 30% longer run time. Featuring updates to mounts, propellers, lift assist systems, drive motors, and software.", "Stow or deploy Ulterra just by pushing a button on your wireless remote, foot pedal, the Minn Kota Fishing App, or a Minn Kota or Humminbird Fish Finder.", "Spend more time fishing and less time fighting the conditions with precise GPS control of your drift path and speed. Drift Mode automatically engages speed and course control simultaneously—even in the heaviest wind and current.", "Adjust to changing fishing conditions without reaching down to your trolling motor. Trim Ulterra® up or down at the push of a button—choose from the foot pedal, wireless remote, Minn Kota® Fishing App, or a Minn Kota® or Humminbird® fish finder. ", "Use the most-trusted navigation system in fishing to keep you on the fish. Ulterra® uses GPS to control your trolling motor with unrivaled features. Set Spot-Lock®, record paths, control speed and steering, and more. Minn Kota® makes boat positioning and control automatic, and you can take command from the easy-to-read LCD screen of Ulterra's wireless remote.", "Explore shallow water worry-free with a clutch system designed to protect your motor from accidental bottom strikes.", "Unlock more fish, structure, and unprecedented underwater clarity with Dual Spectrum CHIRP sonar– providing exceptional 2D sonar with superior target separation. Built-In Dual Spectrum CHIRP Sonar covers a wide range of frequencies and keeps your transducer and wiring completely concealed and protected by running everything through the trolling motor's shaft.", "Keep your hands free. Use the foot pedal to stow, deploy, and adjust the trim on Ulterra®—plus, a user-programmable button keeps the most-used features a tap away, including: marking a waypoint, engaging AutoPilot™, and deploying or retracting Minn Kota® shallow water anchors. Includes 18' cord.", "Know exactly how much time you have on the water. With Real-Time Battery Monitoring, you can check battery power levels while the motor is in use. Also featured is a real-time “time until empty” display monitor, with a notification when battery power is reduced to 20% to prompt users to enter Eco Mode, which can reduce current draw to extend battery life.", "At the core of your Minn Kota® trolling motor is an exceptionally durable composite shaft, now made even stronger with carbon-fiber. It's a Minn Kota® exclusive, and we guarantee it for life.", "2 year limited warranty included, extended to 3 year limited warranty with product registration."]

Product.title: Twin Heron Kayak - Horizon
Product.description: The Twin Heron is a truly unique tandem kayak that also performs well when paddled solo. The Auto Trim Hull is designed to prevent the bow from popping up when seated solo in the stern seat. You can also completely remove the front seat making it perfect for your dog to ride along or easy access to your gear. The Twin Heron comes standard with four flush-mount rod holders, making tandem fishing trips even easier! The Twin Heron is a great option for the outdoors family looking for a versatile tandem kayak. | Old Town Twin Heron Kayak - Horizon

Product.pim_ShortDescription: If summer vibes were a kayak, the Sonata 106 MK would be it! The Sonata 106 MK is easy to maneuver like a kayak but fully motorized like a boat with built-in wireless Bluetooth speakers. Integrated with a Minn Kota electric motor, control your kayak with ease with an intuitive forward-and-reverse throttle beside your seat and steer with your feet using the adjustable foot braces. Be the source of entertainment with your friends during your next trip by wirelessly connecting your phone to enjoy your favorite music, podcast, or e-book. Turn on the LED cockpit lighting to keep the party going as the sun starts to set. Cruise, party, or fish 'til sundown with the Sonata 106 MK.

Product.title: Minn Kota Ultrex QUEST Trolling Motor, 24V/36V, 90/115 lb, 45" Shaft, Humminbird Imaging-DSC, Micro Remote, Instant Response Foot Pedal
Product.description: Minn Kota Ultrex trolling motors give you the control and responsiveness needed to fish most effectively around cover and structure. Choose Ultrex for dependable brushed performance or Ultrex QUEST for brushless power. With precise foot pedal control and responsive steering with no lag or oversteer , Ultrex moves exactly where on the water you want it to. A clear transducer indicator keeps your live sonar aligned with your boat , so you can spend less time correcting your position and more time targeting fish. Plus , every Ultrex comes standard with everything needed to connect to select Humminbird and Minn Kota fish finders , bringing your Minn Kota trolling motor , shallow water anchors , and fish finder together in one seamless fishing system you can control through the Minn Kota Fishing App on iOs or Android devices. | Minn Kota Ultrex QUEST Trolling Motor , 24V/36V , 90/115 lb , 45" Shaft , Humminbird Imaging-DSC , Micro Remote , Instant Response Foot Pedal
Product.google_product_category: Electronics > Electronics Accessories > Remote Controls
Product.pim_marketing_name: Minn Kota Ultrex QUEST Trolling Motor, 24V/36V, 90/115 lb, 45" Shaft, Humminbird Imaging-DSC, Micro Remote, Instant Response Foot Pedal
Product.pim_ANISProductWxHDimensionsIM: 16 in x 14 in
Product.pim_FeatureBulletCombo: ["Spot-Lock® gives you up to a 50% tighter hold to your spot and the power to stay right on top of any productive fishing spot with unparalleled GPS accuracy, so you can remain where you are without touching your trolling motor. ", "Avoid shallow water and protect your equipment—this feature detects depth changes, alerts you immediately, and takes action by automatically engaging Spot-Lock® and deploying your shallow water anchors.", "Getting to your favorite spot is easier than ever. Just draw a course with your finger and the motor automatically takes you where you want to go.", "Keep your bait where the fish are by automatically following depth contours and weed lines.", "From innovative navigation features to precise boat positioning, built-in connectivity let’s you wirelessly manage compatible gear seamlessly across your Minn Kota® system. Simplify the set up and use of your integrated system without complex rigging or cables—keeping everything connected, cleaner, and more organized. ", "Minn Kota® trolling motors, fish finders, maps, sonar, and shallow water anchors all work together for one purpose—fishing. The Minn Kota® system seamlessly integrates what your fish finder sees with what your trolling motor does, turning sonar and mapping data into automated and precise boat positioning so you can stay focused on fishing.", "Easily maneuver to your spot with the most responsive and advanced foot pedal with heel to toe steering speed, a programmable button, Spot-Lock, and 6' cable.", "These 24/36V dual-voltage brushless motors have been completely re-imagined from the ground up, taking the world’s greatest trolling motors and redesigning them to outperform everything else on the water for years to come. Fish longer with the power and precision you need: 50% more torque and 30% longer run time. Featuring updates to mounts, propellers, lift assist systems, drive motors, and software.", "Spend more time fishing and less time fighting the conditions with precise GPS control of your drift path and speed. Drift Mode automatically engages speed and course control simultaneously—even in the heaviest wind and current.", "Use the most-trusted navigation system in fishing to keep you on the fish. Ultrex™ uses GPS to control your trolling motor with unrivaled features. Set Spot-Lock®, record paths, control speed and steering, and more. Minn Kota® makes boat positioning and control automatic, and you can take command from the Ultrex's intuitive micro-remote.", "Unlock more fish, structure, and unprecedented underwater clarity with Dual Spectrum CHIRP sonar– providing exceptional 2D sonar with superior target separation. Built-In Dual Spectrum CHIRP Sonar covers a wide range of frequencies and keeps your transducer and wiring completely concealed and protected by running everything through the trolling motor's shaft.", "Keep precise steering and your most-used feature at your feet with the only foot pedal offering Power Steering and a user-programmable button. Set it to mark a waypoint, engage AutoPilot™, or deploy and retract Minn Kota® shallow water anchors.", "Stow and deploy your motor with half the effort using Ultrex's patented Lift-Assist design, featuring a stainless steel, nitrogen gas-charged spring.", "At the core of your Minn Kota® trolling motor is an exceptionally durable composite shaft, now made even stronger with carbon-fiber. It's a Minn Kota® exclusive, and we guarantee it for life.", "2 year limited warranty included, extended to 3 year limited warranty with product registration."]

Product.pim_ShortDescription: Minn Kota® Ultrex™ trolling motors give you the control and responsiveness needed to fish most effectively around cover and structure. Choose Ultrex for dependable brushed performance or Ultrex QUEST™ for brushless power. With precise foot pedal control and responsive steering with no lag or oversteer, Ultrex moves exactly where on the water you want it to. A clear transducer indicator keeps your live sonar aligned with your boat, so you can spend less time correcting your position and more time targeting fish. Plus, every Ultrex™ comes standard with everything needed to connect to select Humminbird® and Minn Kota® fish finders, bringing your Minn Kota trolling motor, shallow water anchors, and fish finder together in one seamless fishing system you can control through the Minn Kota Fishing App on iOs or Android™ devices.

Choose Ultrex for dependable brushed performance or Ultrex QUEST for brushless power. With precise foot pedal control and responsive steering with no lag or oversteer , Ultrex moves exactly where on the water you want it to. A clear transducer indicator keeps your live sonar aligned with your boat , so you can spend less time correcting your position and more time targeting fish. Plus , every Ultrex comes standard with everything needed to connect to select Humminbird and Minn Kota fish finders , bringing your Minn Kota trolling motor , shallow water anchors , and fish finder together in one seamless fishing system you can control through the Minn Kota Fishing App on iOs or Android devices. | Minn Kota Ultrex QUEST Trolling Motor , 24V/36V , 90/115 lb , 60" Shaft , Humminbird Imaging-DSC , Micro Remote , Instant Response Foot Pedal

Product.pim_FeatureBulletCombo: ["Spot-Lock® gives you up to a 50% tighter hold to your spot and the power to stay right on top of any productive fishing spot with unparalleled GPS accuracy, so you can remain where you are without touching your trolling motor. ", "Avoid shallow water and protect your equipment—this feature detects depth changes, alerts you immediately, and takes action by automatically engaging Spot-Lock® and deploying your shallow water anchors.", "Getting to your favorite spot is easier than ever. Just draw a course with your finger and the motor automatically takes you where you want to go.", "Keep your bait where the fish are by automatically following depth contours and weed lines.", "From innovative navigation features to precise boat positioning, built-in connectivity let’s you wirelessly manage compatible gear seamlessly across your Minn Kota® system. Simplify the set up and use of your integrated system without complex rigging or cables—keeping everything connected, cleaner, and more organized. ", "Minn Kota® trolling motors, fish finders, maps, sonar, and shallow water anchors all work together for one purpose—fishing. The Minn Kota® system seamlessly integrates what your fish finder sees with what your trolling motor does, turning sonar and mapping data into automated and precise boat positioning so you can stay focused on fishing.", "Easily maneuver to your spot with the most responsive and advanced foot pedal with heel to toe steering speed, a programmable button, Spot-Lock, and 6' cable.", "These 24/36V dual-voltage brushless motors have been completely re-imagined from the ground up, taking the world’s greatest trolling motors and redesigning them to outperform everything else on the water for years to come. Fish longer with the power and precision you need: 50% more torque and 30% longer run time. Featuring updates to mounts, propellers, lift assist systems, drive motors, and software.", "Spend more time fishing and less time fighting the conditions with precise GPS control of your drift path and speed. Drift Mode automatically engages speed and course control simultaneously—even in the heaviest wind and current.", "Use the most-trusted navigation system in fishing to keep you on the fish. Ultrex™ uses GPS to control your trolling motor with unrivaled features. Set Spot-Lock®, record paths, control speed and steering, and more. Minn Kota® makes boat positioning and control automatic, and you can take command from the Ultrex's intuitive micro-remote.", "Unlock more fish, structure, and unprecedented underwater clarity with Dual Spectrum CHIRP sonar– providing exceptional 2D sonar with superior target separation. Built-In Dual Spectrum CHIRP Sonar covers a wide range of frequencies and keeps your transducer and wiring completely concealed and protected by running everything through the trolling motor's shaft.", "Keep precise steering and your most-used feature at your feet with the only foot pedal offering Power Steering and a user-programmable button. Set it to mark a waypoint, engage AutoPilot™, or deploy and retract Minn Kota® shallow water anchors.", "Stow and deploy your motor with half the effort using Ultrex's patented Lift-Assist design, featuring a stainless steel, nitrogen gas-charged spring.", "At the core of your Minn Kota® trolling motor is an exceptionally durable composite shaft, now made even stronger with carbon-fiber. It's a Minn Kota® exclusive, and we guarantee it for life.", "2 year limited warranty included, extended to 3 year limited warranty with product registration."]

Product.pim_ShortDescription: Minn Kota® Ultrex™ trolling motors give you the control and responsiveness needed to fish most effectively around cover and structure. Choose Ultrex for dependable brushed performance or Ultrex QUEST™ for brushless power. With precise foot pedal control and responsive steering with no lag or oversteer, Ultrex moves exactly where on the water you want it to. A clear transducer indicator keeps your live sonar aligned with your boat, so you can spend less time correcting your position and more time targeting fish. Plus, every Ultrex™ comes standard with everything needed to connect to select Humminbird® and Minn Kota® fish finders, bringing your Minn Kota trolling motor, shallow water anchors, and fish finder together in one seamless fishing system you can control through the Minn Kota Fishing App on iOs or Android™ devices.

Product.title: ICE XPLORE 9 + MEGA Live 2 Bundle, 10.1 in
Product.description: Take your ice fishing to the next level with the ICE XPLORE + MEGA Live 2 Bundle delivering next-gen clarity, helping anglers catch more fish and enjoy every moment on the ice. Built for hardwater, this bundle delivers unmatched clarity, precision, and control beneath the ice. The XPLORE Series fish finder combines a vivid touchscreen display with intuitive mapping and sonar features, while the MEGA Live 2 provides real-time sonar imaging so you can see fish, structure, and lure action in incredible detail. Outfitted with right-sized, cold-weather-ready cables and accessories tailored for ice fishing, this bundle is ready to hit the ice when you are. | Humminbird ICE XPLORE 9 + MEGA Live 2 Bundle

Product.pim_ShortDescription: The APEX 13 MSI+ Chartplotter provides the clearest sonar imaging on the sharpest multi-function display that anglers have ever seen. See it all with a 13.3" Full-HD touchscreen that provides a customized display of information from advanced network options like NMEA 2000®, HDMI In/Out, WiFi and Bluetooth®. Find your fishing spots faster with included LakeMaster® and CoastMaster® VX Maps. Navigate over 13,000 lakes, waterways, and coastal waters in the United States and Canada with confidence. Tools like 1-foot contours and depth and shallow water highlights help you traverse waters with certainty. Industry-leading MEGA Imaging+ and Dual Spectrum CHIRP sonar come standard, with even more performance from a dedicated sonar channel for accessory 2D CHIRP transducers up to 2kW. Add the power of the One-Boat Network™ to integrate the accuracy of Humminbird GPS charts, unrivaled boat control from Minn Kota®, and reach new depths with wireless Cannon® Optimum™ downrigger control. The APEX Series is a new kind of MFD that will take you fishing to a new level. This CHO (Control Head Only) model is the perfect pairing for anglers looking to select their own transducer, such as a Stainless Steel thru-hull option (SSTH 14 HW MSI+) or simply to add an additional display to an existing Humminbird network.

Product.pim_ShortDescription: The APEX 19 MSI+ Chartplotter provides the clearest sonar imaging on the sharpest multi-function display that anglers have ever seen. See it all with a 18.5" Full-HD touchscreen that provides a customized display of information from advanced network options like NMEA 2000®, HDMI In/Out, WiFi and Bluetooth®. Find your fishing spots faster with included LakeMaster® and CoastMaster® VX Maps. Navigate over 13,000 lakes, waterways, and coastal waters in the United States and Canada with confidence. Tools like 1-foot contours and depth and shallow water highlights help you traverse waters with certainty. Industry-leading MEGA Imaging+ and Dual Spectrum CHIRP sonar come standard, with even more performance from a dedicated sonar channel for accessory 2D CHIRP transducers up to 2kW. Add the power of the One-Boat Network™ to integrate the accuracy of Humminbird GPS charts, unrivaled boat control from Minn Kota®, and reach new depths with wireless Cannon® Optimum™ downrigger control. The APEX Series is a new kind of MFD that will take you fishing to a new level.

Product.title: Minn Kota Ulterra Trolling Motor, 24V, 80 lb Thrust, 45" Shaft, with Humminbird Imaging - Dual Spectrum CHIRP, Wireless Remote, Foot Pedal
Product.description: Minn Kota Ulterra trolling motors make boat control effortless , so you can focus on fishing—even in the harshest conditions. Choose the proven brushed performance of Minn Kota Ulterra or brushless power with Minn Kota Ulterra QUEST. Automatic stow , deploy , and trim make motor adjustments effortless , while the ultra-responsive Ulterra foot pedal and Power Steering deliver the gold standard in precise control and maneuvering. Your motor syncs easily and wirelessly with a Minn Kota fish finder powered by Humminbird Imaging , creating a connected fishing system with no extra cables. Ulterra is filled with intelligent navigation features that do the work for you. Draw & Navigate lets you draw a course on your fish finder and have the motor follow it , while Follow Mode and Drift Mode automatically guide your boat along productive water and controlled drift paths. Intelligent Depth Control actively avoids shallow water while trolling to help protect your equipment and keep you on the fish. | Minn Kota Ulterra Trolling Motor , 24V , 80 lb Thrust , 45" Shaft , with Humminbird Imaging - Dual Spectrum CHIRP , Wireless Remote , Foot Pedal

Product.pim_FeatureBulletCombo: ["Spot-Lock® gives you up to a 50% tighter hold to your spot and the power to stay right on top of any productive fishing spot with unparalleled GPS accuracy, so you can remain where you are without touching your trolling motor. ", "Avoid shallow water and protect your equipment—this feature detects depth changes, alerts you immediately, and takes action by automatically engaging Spot-Lock® and deploying your shallow water anchors.", "Getting to your favorite spot is easier than ever. Just draw a course with your finger and the motor automatically takes you where you want to go.", "Keep your bait where the fish are by automatically following depth contours and weed lines.", "From innovative navigation features to precise boat positioning, built-in connectivity let’s you wirelessly manage compatible gear seamlessly across your Minn Kota® system. Simplify the set up and use of your integrated system without complex rigging or cables—keeping everything connected, cleaner, and more organized. ", "Minn Kota® trolling motors, fish finders, maps, sonar, and shallow water anchors all work together for one purpose—fishing. The Minn Kota® system seamlessly integrates what your fish finder sees with what your trolling motor does, turning sonar and mapping data into automated and precise boat positioning so you can stay focused on fishing.", "Spend more time fishing and less time fighting the conditions with precise GPS control of your drift path and speed. Drift Mode automatically engages speed and course control simultaneously—even in the heaviest wind and current.", "Use the most-trusted navigation system in fishing to keep you on the fish. Terrova® uses GPS to control your trolling motor with unrivaled features. Set Spot-Lock®, record paths, control speed and steering, and more. Minn Kota® makes boat positioning and control automatic, and you can take command from the easy-to-read LCD screen of Terrova's wireless remote.", "Unlock more fish, structure, and unprecedented underwater clarity with Dual Spectrum CHIRP sonar– providing exceptional 2D sonar with superior target separation. Built-In Dual Spectrum CHIRP Sonar covers a wide range of frequencies and keeps your transducer and wiring completely concealed and protected by running everything through the trolling motor's shaft.", "Steer your way with two steering options: heel/toe pedal and left/right steering buttons. The low-profile design includes Spot-Lock® activation, rotary speed control dial, momentary/constant on toggle, AutoPilot™ on/off toggle, and 18' cable with waterproof connector plug.", "At the core of your Minn Kota® trolling motor is an exceptionally durable composite shaft. It's a Minn Kota® exclusive, and we guarantee it for life.", "Fall-away ramps will effortlessly slide your trolling motor into the water with the push of a lever.", "2 year limited warranty included, extended to 3 year limited warranty with product registration."]

Product.title: Minn Kota Riptide Terrova Trolling Motor, 12V, 55 lb Thrust, 54" Shaft, Wireless Remote
Product.description: Take total control of your bay boat or skiff with Minn Kota Riptide Terrova brushed and Riptide Terrova QUEST brushless trolling motors , purpose-built for precise positioning and lasting performance in harsh saltwater environments. Quiet operation and Drift Mode automatically maintain your intended drift path and speed , while improved Spot-Lock GPS delivers up to a 50% tighter hold to your spot in wind , current , and tidal movement. Draw & Navigate lets you draw a course on your connected Minn Kota fish finder and then simply let your Minn Kota trolling motor take you to your spot , while Intelligent Depth Control automatically notifies you of shallow water as you actively troll from shallow flats to deeper channels , helping protect your equipment while you stay on the fish. Your Riptide Terrova trolling motor and Minn Kota fish finder sync easily and wirelessly with no cables needed , and you can control the motor from your fish finder , wireless remote , or the Minn Kota Fishing App. Instant Response Steering on Riptide Terrova QUEST models provides advanced responsiveness for precise trolling and boat positioning. Riptide Terrova is purpose built to make navigating the elements feel effortless. | Minn Kota Riptide Terrova Trolling Motor , 12V , 55 lb Thrust , 54" Shaft , Wireless Remote

Product.pim_ShortDescription: Take total control of your bay boat or skiff with Minn Kota Riptide Terrova® brushed and Riptide Terrova QUEST™ brushless trolling motors, purpose-built for precise positioning and lasting performance in harsh saltwater environments. Quiet operation and Drift Mode automatically maintain your intended drift path and speed, while improved Spot-Lock® GPS delivers up to a 50% tighter hold to your spot in wind, current, and tidal movement. Draw and Navigate™ lets you draw a course on your connected Minn Kota® fish finder and then simply let your Minn Kota® trolling motor take you to your spot, while Intelligent Depth Control™ automatically notifies you of shallow water as you actively troll from shallow flats to deeper channels, helping protect your equipment while you stay on the fish. Your Riptide Terrova trolling motor and Minn Kota® fish finder sync easily and wirelessly with no cables needed, and you can control the motor from your fish finder, wireless remote, or the Minn Kota Fishing App. Instant Response Steering on Riptide Terrova QUEST models provides advanced responsiveness for precise trolling and boat positioning. Riptide Terrova is purpose built to make navigating the elements feel effortless.

Built for dependable performance and everyday reliability , PowerDrive gives you intuitive boat control through your choice of a foot pedal or wireless remote. Foot pedal models offer responsive , hands-free control , while wireless remote models add GPS-enabled features like AutoPilot , Cruise Control , and improved Spot-Lock GPS with up to a 50% tighter hold to your spot. Plus , wireless connectivity with Minn Kota fish finders creates a clean , integrated fishing system without the hassle of extra cables. | Minn Kota PowerDrive Trolling Motor , 12V , 55 lb Thrust , 54" Shaft , Micro Remote

Product.title: Minn Kota Riptide PowerDrive Trolling Motor, 12V, 55 lb Thrust, 54" Shaft, Micro Remote
Product.description: Minn Kota Riptide PowerDrive trolling motors simplify saltwater boat control , so you can focus on fishing through changing wind , waves , current , and tidal movement. Drift Mode automatically manages your drift path and speed , while Draw & Navigate lets you draw a course on your connected Minn Kota fish finder and have your Minn Kota trolling motor take over. Improved Spot-Lock GPS delivers up to a 50% tighter hold to keep you on your fishing spot , and Intelligent Depth Control automatically notifies you of shallow water , helping protect your equipment while you stay on the fish. Seamless integration with Minn Kota fish finders , powered by Humminbird Imaging , creates a connected fishing system , while control from your fish finder , wireless remote , or Minn Kota Fishing App puts motor operation wherever it's most convenient. Built to withstand demanding saltwater conditions , Riptide PowerDrive handles the boat control so you can focus on getting more bites. | Minn Kota Riptide PowerDrive Trolling Motor , 12V , 55 lb Thrust , 54" Shaft , Micro Remote

Product.title: Sportsman 120 Pro Kayak - Sierra
Product.description: For the angler who aspires to fish with no limits, the Sportsman 120 PRO is a compact fishing kayak built to deliver serious capability in a right-sized platform. Designed for anglers who want to customize their setup, the 120 PRO offers exceptional stability, generous capacity, and a wide, open cockpit with room to rig the boat their way. Power-ready by design, it features clean bow and stern motor mounting options, steering-ready cable routing, and thru-hull wiring ports that make it easy to add motors, electronics, and accessories over time. With premium gear management and abundant storage, the 120 PRO delivers a feature-rich platform built for confident fishing. | Old Town Sportsman 120 Pro Kayak - Sierra

Product.pim_ShortDescription: Minn Kota® Ultrex™ trolling motors give you the control and responsiveness needed to fish most effectively around cover and structure. Choose Ultrex for dependable brushed performance or Ultrex QUEST™ for brushless power. With precise foot pedal control and responsive steering with no lag or oversteer, Ultrex moves exactly where on the water you want it to. A clear transducer indicator keeps your live sonar aligned with your boat, so you can spend less time correcting your position and more time targeting fish. Plus, every Ultrex™ comes standard with everything needed to connect to select Humminbird® and Minn Kota® fish finders, bringing your Minn Kota trolling motor, shallow water anchors, and fish finder together in one seamless fishing system you can control through the Minn Kota Fishing App on iOs or Android™ devices.

Product.pim_ShortDescription: Minn Kota™ X Series™ Fish Finders combine industry-leading Humminbird Imaging™ , innovative navigation features, seamless wireless control, and exceptional display clarity to help anglers find, navigate to, and stay on fish with confidence. With Minn Kota™ Maps included, the Minn Kota X Series uses cutting-edge sonar to give you a clearer, more complete picture of structure and fish. As the brains of your seamless fishing system, what your fish finder sees is what your trolling motor does, so you can navigate to a favorite waypoint or use the new Draw and Navigate feature to let your Minn Kota trolling motor take you to your desired spot. Once you find the fish, innovative navigation features like Intelligent Depth Control let you avoid shallow-water while protecting your equipment. Plus, get best-in-class clarity and brightness with a high-resolution touchscreen—even in rain, high sun, or when wearing polarized lenses. Control it all with the Minn Kota® Fishing App. Spend less time looking and more time fishing with Minn Kota X Series.

Product.title: Scubapro Hydros Pro 2 BCD, W/AIR 2, Black/Army Green, X-Small

Featuring an all-new monorail weight system, heavy-duty quick-dry bladder, lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate, and new Super Cinch 2 tank band, this second-generation BCD is engineered for divers who demand the best. With a modular design, premium materials, and travel-ready features, the Hydros Pro 2 is built for ultimate performance in all dive conditions.

Product.pim_FeatureBulletCombo: ["Weight pockets slide and lock in via a monorail system for easy single-handed operation. Simply pull the grey D-handle to release. Comes with Standard size weight pockets, Mini size available separately.", "The heavy-duty quick dry bladder’s Instant Dry Technology enables the BCD to dry almost instantly, making it ideal for travel due to less water retention and lower post-dive weight.", "Built to last with a fabric-free Monprene® gel harness and double-coated fabric bladder designed to resist abrasion and fading from pool chemicals, saltwater and sunlight. Anti-abrasion Cordura® fabric on the dorsal weight-wing adds further protection against abrasions.", "Lightweight Ergo-Lite back plate is 25% lighter than the Hydros Pro’s back plate and provides a body-contoured shape, soft padding, and dual top/bottom handles for easy two-handed loading.", "Body-contoured shape and 3D ergonomic design hug the body for a weightless feel. Torso flex zone automatically adjusts to your torso length for excellent comfort and freedom of movement. Unrestricted internal air-flow design reduces air trapping so you enjoy greater maneuverability and can easily deflate the BCD from any angle or position.", "Super Cinch 2 tank band is simple, ultra-durable, and incredibly easy to use and adjust. Enables fast and easy tank switches whether you’re swapping out tanks between dives or switching between aluminum 80s and steel tanks when traveling.", "Smart-Pack design enables the shoulder and waist straps to be folded flat against the backpack and wrapped in the wing for easy transport and storage.", "Shoulder strap hinges lock in the open position for easy donning and then fold flat to allow the Hydros Pro 2 to pack up small for travel.", "Body grip gel helps the BCD grip to your body, preventing shifting and riding up during the dive.", "Tri-bungee retraction system with 2-stage inflation allows for a more streamlined and compact air-cell underwater, providing an even air distribution and higher lift capacity at the surface.", "Near-zero inherent buoyancy means less lead and better control underwater.", "Weight pockets are self-draining for an easy, hassle-free experience. Standard size holds up to 10 lbs per pocket.", "With the BC-4-Life Modular Design, components are fully customizable and interchangeable, simplifying the repair process and extending the BCD’s lifespan.", "Multi-Mount System on the BCD includes multiple D-rings and mounting points to easily configure your BCD. Optional Multi-Mount Accessory Plates and Hydros Bungee Sets sold separately to easily attach knives, lights, pockets, SMBs, hoses and more."]

Product.google_product_category: Sporting Goods > Outdoor Recreation > Boating & Water Sports > Boating & Rafting > Kayak Accessories
Product.pim_FeatureBulletCombo: ["Fill and seal scratches and gouges in three-layer polyethylene and Oltonar/Royalex canoes and kayaks", "Contains 25 ml of adhesive", "PLEASE NOTE: Continental U.S. shipping only. No express shipping. Cannot ship by air because of hazardous materials."]
Product.pim_ShortDescription:
This two-part methacrylate adhesive is used for filling and sealing scratches and gouges in three layer polyethylene and Oltonar/Royalex canoes and kayaks. Combined at a 1:1 ratio, it has a working time of 15-18 minutes and fixture time of 30-35 minutes at room temperature. 731MMA offers a combination of high strength and stiffness as well as the ability to bond a wide range of materials.
PLEASE NOTE: Continental U.S. shipping only. No express shipping. Cannot ship by air because of hazardous materials.

Product.title: Scubapro Nexus Snorkel
Product.description: The NEXUS is one of SCUBAPRO's premium snorkels. It features an oval-shaped, large-bore upper barrel that minimizes drag while allowing lots of air to flow. The barrel is fitted with a splashguard-style top to deflect surface water. At the other end there's an angled purge valve designed to divert bubbles out of your line of sight. The rotating mouthpiece can be positioned perfectly for maximum comfort. When breathing off a regulator, the snorkel's corrugated lower section drops out of the way. The NEXUS offers another handy feature: the upper barrel is flexible, so you can fold it for stowage in a BC pocket.

Product.title: Scubapro Nexus Snorkel
Product.description: The NEXUS is one of SCUBAPRO's premium snorkels. It features an oval-shaped, large-bore upper barrel that minimizes drag while allowing lots of air to flow. The barrel is fitted with a splashguard-style top to deflect surface water. At the other end there's an angled purge valve designed to divert bubbles out of your line of sight. The rotating mouthpiece can be positioned perfectly for maximum comfort. When breathing off a regulator, the snorkel's corrugated lower section drops out of the way. The NEXUS offers another handy feature: the upper barrel is flexible, so you can fold it for stowage in a BC pocket.

Product.title: Scubapro Twin Jet Max Fin in Gray, Small
Product.description: A well-designed split fin is fast and maneuverable, enabling you to cover a lot of ground without cramping leg muscles or straining ankles. The TWIN JET MAX features a dual-compound design that offers a slightly stiffer blade with a little more feedback than what you might expect in a flexier fin. Employing what's known as "propeller technology," the distinctive split hydrofoil shape of the TWIN JET MAX blade allows water to flow between and around each of the twin blades, which flex independently to produce propulsion. An extended soleplate provides additional leverage to improve the power transfer from foot to fin. Product.title: Scubapro Spectra Mini Dive Mask, Small
Product.description: Not every face can wear a full-sized Spectra. That's why SCUBAPRO offers the SPECTRA MINI. This compact mask offers all of the comfort and performance features of the standard Spectra but is designed for small or narrow faces. The dual lens SPECTRA MINI offers a wide view and a comfortable water-blocking seal, plus it features a low volume design for easy clearing. It uses a smart double-sealed silicone skirt for optimum comfort and its buckle and strap system is easy to use. Buckles attach to the skirt to optimize strap angle for achieving that perfect fit, plus they enable the mask to be folded flat for easy packing. An exclusive paint process in a choice of colors turns the SPECTRA MINI into a stylish, as well as dependable, dive mask.

Product.title: Scubapro Crystal Vu Plus Dive Mask, w/ Purge in Black
Product.description: The CRYSTAL VU PLUS's large single lens design plus seamless side windows equal an expansive view under water, and the no-tint glass makes that view extremely clear. Offering new styling with low internal volume, the crystal-clear double-sealed silicone skirt offers a seal that is both comfortable against the skin and watertight while producing a very open, airy feel that's especially nice when diving in darker waters. Swivel buckles allow for the perfect fit and an exclusive paint process lets you dive with style.

Swivel buckles allow for the perfect fit and an exclusive paint process lets you dive with style.

Product.title: Scubapro Spectra Mini Dive Mask, Small
Product.description: Not every face can wear a full-sized Spectra. That's why SCUBAPRO offers the SPECTRA MINI. This compact mask offers all of the comfort and performance features of the standard Spectra but is designed for small or narrow faces. The dual lens SPECTRA MINI offers a wide view and a comfortable water-blocking seal, plus it features a low volume design for easy clearing. It uses a smart double-sealed silicone skirt for optimum comfort and its buckle and strap system is easy to use. Buckles attach to the skirt to optimize strap angle for achieving that perfect fit, plus they enable the mask to be folded flat for easy packing. An exclusive paint process in a choice of colors turns the SPECTRA MINI into a stylish, as well as dependable, dive mask.

Product.title: Scubapro Jet Sport Fin in Gray, X-Small
Product.description: The JET SPORT FULL FOOT is lightweight yet delivers lots of propulsion, excellent maneuverability, plus it feels oh-so-comfy on bare feet. Its slightly stiff blade is a tri-material design featuring a pair of soft rubber panels framed in semi-stiff plastic and flanked by thin side rails, producing just the right amount of flex. There are also drag-reducing vents between the blade and foot pocket to decrease resistance on both up and down strokes. This combination generates propulsive kicking power, provides good stability and makes efficient work of frog and dolphin kicks. The rubber full foot pocket molds comfortably to your foot, and the non-skid pattern is effective on wet decks. A great choice for finning in the tropics.
